695:  frontend:
696-    # Served behind oauth2-proxy (docker-compose) which owns http://localhost:3000
697-    # and enforces the Keycloak login before proxying to this dev server.
698-    command: pnpm dev --host 0.0.0.0 --port 3002
699-    working_dir: ./01-frontend/frontend

701-      - VITE_DEV_API_MODE=port-forwarding

703-      # create_secrets.sh wrote to .env. The S3 origins must equal the origin of the presigned
704-      # URLs (S3_EXTERNAL_URL on the document-management service below).
